name: rice_disease_v1
deployment_status: REJECTED. Not bundled in the app. See evaluation.

training_data.rice: Paddy Doctor via Kaggle (imbikramsaha/paddy-doctor), 10,407 smartphone field images, 10 classes including normal. 8,842 train / 1,565 validation, stratified random split.

evaluation.cross_dataset_source: Mendeley 'Rice Leaf Disease Image Samples' (fwcj7stb8r), 5,932 images, different collectors and region, never trained on
evaluation.note: The cross-dataset accuracy of 0.159 is BELOW the 0.25 chance level for its four classes. Predictions spread across all ten classes at near-random rates rather than collapsing to one, which indicates the model learned features specific to the Paddy Doctor collection - camera, framing, background, growth stage - rather than disease morphology. Training longer made this worse: in-domain rose from 0.545 to 0.701 while cross-dataset fell from 0.280 to 0.159. That divergence is the signature of dataset overfitting.

split_rule: Stratified random. Paddy Doctor filenames are bare sequential ids and carry no source-leaf grouping, so the by-source split used for PlantVillage could not be applied. The in-domain figure is optimistic for this reason.
limitations: NOT FIT FOR DEPLOYMENT. Cross-dataset accuracy is below chance.
Covers rice only. The other 13 crops in the AgriN registry are unsupported and must route to cloud diagnosis.
Trained on a single collection from one region of Tamil Nadu; performance on other geographies, seasons and cameras is unmeasured and likely worse.
Class imbalance was 5:1 and handled by loss weighting only, not resampling.
Trained on CPU for 24 epochs and still improving at cutoff, so it is undertrained as well as non-generalising.
intended_use: None at present. Published so peer nodes can see the negative result and avoid repeating it.
license: Apache-2.0 (weights); source datasets keep their own licences.

rejected_strategies: int8 (uint8 I/O) - artifact failed allocate_tensors: 'Node 119 failed to prepare'. MobileNetV3 hard-swish and squeeze-excite blocks do not survive an int8-only op set.
int8 weights with float activations - same allocation failure.
quantisation.note: Every candidate artifact is smoke-tested by loading it and running one inference before it is accepted.
